newsitem.title: USA: Tosco Bayway FCC unit down after small fire.
newsitem.headline: Tosco Bayway FCC unit down after small fire.

text.p: The fluid catalytic cracking unit at Tosco Corp's Bayway, New Jersey plant is temporarily out of action after a small fire on Wednesday night, according to a source familiar with the plants operations.

"The cat cracker at Bayway had an upset last night and there was a release of some catalyst -- alumina silicate. It is non-hazardous and non-toxic and there were no injuries. There was a small fire at a relief valve but it was promptly put out," the source said.
He couldn't say when the FCC would be back up.
The cat cracker has a rated capacity of 140,000 barrels a day (bpd), one of the largest in the world. The overall distillation capacity at Bayway is 290,000 bpd.
